notes.page_summary: The continuing paragraph discusses profinite completions prime to p, with an above-line Artin-Mazur qualification, and contrasts a programme approachable in characteristic zero with extra amusement or mystery in positive characteristic for varieties that refuse even birational lifting. After a separator the author says he cannot at present draw a precise programme for adequate algebraic structures from these geometric cogitations. He then asks how much cohomological information with variable coefficients, multiplication and possibly other operations is needed to recover an ordinary homotopy type. The question continues at the page foot.
